description: Abstract is a single dense 278-word block of text in IEEEtran 10pt two-column format with cramped leading and heavy inline notation.
cause: Use of IEEEtran conference template designed for 4-page limits rather than standalone preprint format.
correction: Migrate to Candidate A (11pt single-column academic article format with 1-inch margins and structured paragraphs).

description: Figures fig1_architecture, fig2_state_construction, fig3_provenance_chain, and fig4_empirical_results exist in the directory but are never included in the document via \includegraphics.
cause: Omission of figure environments during Phase XVI LaTeX drafting.
correction: Embed all four high-resolution vector figures in dedicated figure environments with comprehensive captions.

description: Phase XVI reports state '10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables', but the compiled PDF is only 5 pages without figures.
cause: Report copied an unverified planning projection instead of measuring the actual compiled PDF output.
correction: Reconstruct manuscript with full scientific depth, figures, and appendices to reach ~12-15 substantive pages, and update all metadata with verified page counts.

description: Table I spans two columns with narrow rigid widths, causing awkward hyphenation and cramped typography.
correction: Rebuild as a full-width booktabs table with tabularx in single-column layout.

description: Compiler reports overfull \hbox (12.97pt too wide) at Table II and in results paragraphs.
cause: Narrow 3.5-inch column width forcing mathematical expressions and table cells beyond column margins.
correction: Single-column 6.5-inch text block eliminates column-width overfull boxes.
Format reproduction block with standard listing or wrapped bash formatting in single-column.

description: Critical experimental details (all 20 problem texts, prompt templates, verifier pseudocode, and trace forensics) were omitted from the PDF.
cause: Conference 4-page space constraints carried over into preprint draft.
correction: Include complete Appendices A through F providing full benchmark registry, tokenization templates, and verification algorithms.
